name: Knot outer half: quest areas
notes: The main quest's Knot areas in the knot-outer scene (mw-e26.9). The player-filtered volume `knot-outer-ring` is the quest area of that id (enter-the-knot: the breach landing and the whole ring), and `ossuary-galleries` is the area reach-the-ossuary (the entry hall, the pit, the garden and the east gallery). The quest reads both, so they are not wired. The Chapel's portcullis has its own graph (chapel-portcullis), placed by the scene beside this one.
